companion.title: Companion mode: tune while you play
companion.dry_run: Dry run: nothing is sent to OpenTabletDriver and nothing can be saved.
companion.area.need_tablet: The tablet size is unknown, so the area is not enlarged (it could leave the tablet).
companion.poll.stop_here: You have liked the same setting more than once: this is a good moment to press Keep and stop tuning.
companion.reverted: The previous working settings were restored.
companion.game.running: osu! is running ({flavor}). Use the hotkeys while you play.
companion.game.not_running: osu! not detected. You can still tune with the buttons or hotkeys.
companion.live.unsaved: Live in OpenTabletDriver, NOT saved ({n} changes). Restarting OTD would undo them; press Keep to save.
companion.live.saved: Everything live is saved ({n} changes in this session).
companion.live.converged: Your answers have settled on one point: press Keep.
companion.live.levels: Steps from start: smoothing {motion}, rest {rest}, area {area}
companion.live.nothing_tunable: The profile has no filter the companion can tune.
companion.hints.caveat: Hints come from the cursor only, not from the game: treat them as a second opinion.
companion.hints.none: Cursor hints appear after a change once there is enough play to compare.
companion.hotkeys.unavailable: Global hotkeys are only available on Windows. Use the buttons.
companion.hotkeys.conflict: These shortcuts are used by another program and do not work: {actions}. Change them in Shortcuts.
companion.hotkeys.ok: Hotkeys work while osu! has the focus. A beep confirms each change (overlays are hidden in exclusive fullscreen).
companion.policy.tune_only: Only adjust the values of my current filters
companion.policy.installed: May also switch on my installed filters
companion.policy.allow_new: May also suggest plugins I do not have (never installs anything)
companion.limits: The companion sees the cursor, not the game. Each change rebuilds the OTD filter chain, which can cause a tiny hitch: change things in breaks or between maps. If you press Save/Apply in the OpenTabletDriver window, its own copy replaces these live settings.
companion.close.title: Unsaved live settings
companion.close.body:
The settings live in OpenTabletDriver are not saved.

Yes: keep them (save).
No: go back to the settings from before the companion.
Cancel: stay here.
adapt.inner_capped: {filter}: the inner radius was lowered from {old} to {new} so it stays within the outer radius.
adapt.converged: Your answers for {axis} go back and forth around one point: it is probably right. Press Keep.
adapt.shared_axis: {filter} has no separate control for this, so its smoothing was used.
adapt.limit.more: No more {axis} is possible with your filters (every value is at its safe maximum).
adapt.limit.less: Your filters are already at their minimum {axis}. For even less, switch a filter off in OpenTabletDriver.
adapt.skip.saturn: {filter} is left as it is: it has too many linked options to tune by feel.
adapt.skip.not_smoothing: {filter} is not a smoothing filter and is left as it is.
adapt.skip.unknown: {filter} is unknown to this program and is left as it is.
adapt.skip.disabled: {filter} is switched off; your policy keeps it that way.
adapt.nothing_to_reduce: There is no {axis} filter to reduce: the cursor is already as direct as it gets.
adapt.nothing_to_tune: Your profile has no filter that controls {axis}. Allow installed filters in "What may be changed" to add one.
adapt.suggest: Suggestion: the plugin "{plugin}" ({filter}) would help here. Install it yourself from the OpenTabletDriver plugin manager if you want it.
adapt.area.unknown: The current area is unknown, so it cannot be scaled.
adapt.area.at_max: The area cannot grow more without leaving the tablet.
adapt.area.at_min: The area is already very small (minimum width {min} mm).
livetune.clamped: {filter} · {param}: {value} is outside the safe range, {new} was used.
livetune.error.no_profile: OpenTabletDriver has no profile for the tablet {tablet}.
livetune.error.area_empty: That area is empty and was not applied.
livetune.error.area_outside: An area of {w} x {h} mm does not fit on the tablet and was not applied.
livetune.error.patch: The change could not be prepared: {detail}
livetune.error.send: OpenTabletDriver did not accept the change.
livetune.error.daemon: OpenTabletDriver is not running: changes cannot be applied live.
livetune.error.rpc: Could not talk to OpenTabletDriver; the change was not applied.
livetune.reverted_all: Back to the settings from before the companion.
livetune.keep.disabled: Saving is not possible in this mode.
livetune.keep.no_config: The OpenTabletDriver settings folder is unknown, so nothing can be saved.
livetune.keep.no_backup: No backup could be made, so nothing was saved. {detail}
livetune.keep.send_failed: The last change did not reach OpenTabletDriver, so nothing was saved.
livetune.keep.write_failed: The settings file could not be written: {detail}
livetune.keep.ok: Saved into OpenTabletDriver's settings.json. Backup of the previous file: {path}
passive.jitter.better: Less cursor jitter at rest since the change ({before} -> {after} mm, {strength} effect).
passive.jitter.worse: More cursor jitter at rest since the change ({before} -> {after} mm, {strength} effect).
passive.jitter.similar: Cursor jitter at rest about the same ({before} -> {after} mm).
passive.jitter.not_enough_data: Jitter at rest: not enough still moments yet to compare.
passive.path.better: Cursor path smoother since the change ({before} -> {after}, {strength} effect).
passive.path.worse: Cursor path rougher since the change ({before} -> {after}, {strength} effect).
passive.path.similar: Cursor path smoothness about the same ({before} -> {after}).
passive.path.not_enough_data: Path smoothness: not enough movement yet to compare.
passive.rate.info: Cursor updates while moving: {before} -> {after} per second.
companion.step.title: Step
companion.step.now: Step: {level}. The next presses use it.
companion.last.none: No change yet. Press a shortcut while you play.
companion.last.undone: Undone: the previous values are live again.
companion.hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
companion.hotkeys.intro: Press Detect, then the key combination here, in this window. Use Ctrl, Alt or Shift plus one key. You can also type it (for example Ctrl+Alt+Up) and press Apply. An empty field means no shortcut.
companion.hotkeys.listening: Press the combination for "{action}" (Esc cancels). The shortcuts are paused meanwhile.
companion.hotkeys.need_modifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift together with the key.
companion.hotkeys.unknown_key: That key cannot be a shortcut. Try a letter, a number, F1-F24, the arrows or PageUp/PageDown.
companion.hotkeys.taken: {combo} is already the shortcut for "{other}". Pick another combination.
companion.hotkeys.invalid: Not understood: {actions}. Fix the text or use Detect. Nothing was changed.
companion.hotkeys.duplicate: The same combination is used twice: {actions}. Each shortcut must be different. Nothing was changed.
companion.hotkeys.notes: Your shortcuts are saved for next time. Limits: on Spanish keyboards AltGr equals Ctrl+Alt, so these combinations do not reach osu! chat. Some graphics drivers use Ctrl+Alt+arrows; if a shortcut does not respond, change it here.
